:::{#def-equivalence-class}
#### Equivalence class

Let $\sim$ be an [equivalence relation](#def-equivalence-relation) on a [set](sets.qmd#def-set) $S$,
and let $a \in S$.
The **equivalence class**
[@wikipedia_equivalence_class]
of $a$ is the set of elements of $S$ related to $a$:

$$
[a] \eqdef \set{b \in S : b \sim a}.
$$

:::
